jobs_results.title: Sr Backend Developer - Ruby, Ruby on Rails
jobs_results.description:
About Zen Educate

Our mission is to change the world of education recruitment. Schools spend over £2bn a year on agency staff, with over £600m per year of that spent on fees that go straight to the recruitment agencies. So far, we've saved UK schools over £10m in supply teaching recruitment costs, and that number grows every day, meaning the funding can be put back into education within the schools. Using our online platform, schools have access to hundreds of profiles of fully vetted teachers and support staff, who they can book at a click of a button. Think Uber for teachers. We are well-funded by high-profile investors and are led by start-up veterans behind two of London's most prominent tech companies.

Building on the success of Zen Educate, in 2020 we launched Zen Locum — an online platform that matches locums (temporary workers) with pharmacies and opticians. With significant early traction we're looking to expand this team to continue driving growth.

We're well-funded by... high-profile investors and are led by start-up veterans behind two of London’s most prominent tech companies.

About The Role

Our mission is to change the world of education recruitment. Schools spend over £2bn a year on agency staff, with over £600m per year of that spent on fees that go straight to the recruitment agencies. So far, we've saved UK schools over £10m in supply teaching recruitment costs, and that number grows every day, meaning the funding can be put back into education within the schools. Using our online platform, schools have access to hundreds of profiles of fully vetted teachers and support staff, who they can book at a click of a button. Think Uber for teachers. We are well-funded by high-profile investors and are led by start-up veterans behind two of London's most prominent tech companies.

What You’ll Do

You’ll be joining Zen in a key position. The product delivery team is a crucial part of how Zen will help both transform the supply and recruitment experience for schools and generate the savings the education system needs. This is a great opportunity for someone looking to apply themselves for a great cause and with great responsibility and autonomy to shape our product and development for years to come. We're looking for talented engineer looking to take their skills to the next level by joining a growing, high-performing product delivery team in an agile environment. You'll be:
• Picking up, owning and deploying new features from scratch, working closely with front-end developers
• Reviewing PRs and helping us improve our ways of working
• Investigating and tackling new challenges and responding to bugs
• Writing high quality, well-tested code

What You’ll Bring
• Experience with Ruby, Ruby on Rails (6yrs+)
• Experience refactoring legacy code and considering trade-offs around technical debt - A top performer that wants to be part of a high-performing, motivated team
• Growth mindset — dedicated to growing your skills as a professional
• Passion for work with a positive social impact

jobs_results.title: Ruby Software Engineer II
jobs_results.description:
✅WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED:
• 2+ years of experience developing and supporting critical business applications
• Excellent communicator and collaborator
• Experience building web applications and REST APIs with Ruby/Ruby on Rails
• Extensive experience with at least one modern frontend JavaScript framework (Vue preferred)
• Demonstrated experience with Git and release/branching strategies
• Experience with code reviews and able to provide feedback and guidance to colleagues
• Proficient in English (C1 or higher)

✅PRIMEREVENUE PERKS:
• 🌎Generous benefits and time off programs
• 🚀Professional growth, learning, and development opportunities
• 🧠Innovative, global, TEAM centric environment
• ✨ Competitive pay, bonus, and retirement programs
• 🏡Collaborative, casual, fun, and flexible work environment with access to top technology, stocked breakrooms, and coffee bars
• 🎉TEAM events and employee celebrations

✅A DAY IN THE LIFE:
• Develop new features and product improvements using... Ruby, Rails, and Vue.js
• Participate in the building of product through the entire software development lifecycle – research, planning, development, deployment, and support
• Understand modern and legacy application architectures to support our application, fix defects, and add required features
• Participate in product deployments and ongoing support rotation
• Participate in, and reinforce, our agile development practice
• Participate in our engineer hiring process
• Actively work to make our products better through:

-Research and implementation of software development best practices

-Architectural design and planning sessions

-TDD (Test Driven Development) and code reviews

-Identification and documentation of product improvement areas

✅ARE YOU READY TO WORK AT PRIMEREVENUE?

PrimeRevenue is a global FinTech based in Atlanta, GA. We've been serving Fortune 500 companies and their suppliers since 2003, and we're growing faster than ever.

WHO ARE YOU?

SMART, HUNGRY, & HUMBLE PERSONALITY IS A MUST! 💯

Our values are built upon what we call PRIDE + Integrity –
• Performance, Respect, Innovation, Diversity, Excellence and, above all, Integrity. At PrimeRevenue, you will work with a great global TEAM that is pursuing a massive overall opportunity

jobs_results.title: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer
jobs_results.description:
What your new job and team will be like:

You will be joining a distributed team that is hard focused on the essential development of features which are allowing the company to continue growing. This work will be carried out within an environment focused on the balance between fostering growth and adherence to best practices (eg. test driven development, clean coding, functional programming, etc). While you will be mainly working in Ruby on Rails your experience with other tools will be highly valued as it will add to the success of the team in building, deploying and maintaining their web based applications.

What we would like to see in you:
• Experience with developing in Ruby on Rails or solid experience with similar technologies and proven track record of quickly adapting to new environments and tools.
• Preference for adherence to best practices and demonstrable understanding of efficient and productive development philosophies and methodologies (eg. Agile, TDD, Functional... Programming).
• Ability to communicate in English at a professional level.
• Strong drive to collaborate within a team, supporting in the growth of colleagues while also focusing on your own continued growth.

What you can expect in return:
• A culture and spirit focused on motivating you to keep growing, to be achieved through; active mentorship, access to courses and certifications and challenging projects which will help progress your technical knowledge by applying the skills you are learning within a practical context.
• 25 days off per year
• Private Health Insurance
• Work permit or relocation support to Spain (if the candidate needs/wants it) or the ability to work remotely (if based within +2/-1 Central European Time Zone).

The process you are going to succeed in:
• Short intro call (20 mins) with Good Roll.
• Interview with client People Team member.
• Technical Take Home Test & Subsequent Peer Review.
• Final Call to meet your new colleagues
